_coverage.title: Never call it for someone who is only unsure about booking.

name: hesitant_new_patient_asks_for_more_info
input: Yeah, I'm just not ready to book anything right now. Can we just leave it for now and I’ll think about it?

conversation.content: Hi, I got a text about setting up a new patient visit. I'm not sure I want to book yet, just trying to figure out if I actually need to come in.

Hi, this is Robin from Bramblewood Clinic. I can help with booking and clinic questions, but I can’t give medical advice. Are you mainly wondering about what kind of visit it would be and how it works here?

grading_criteria: The assistant should recognize that the user is only unsure about booking, not asking to stop all texts. It must not call opt_out. A good response reassures the user that there's no pressure to book, offers a brief explanation of what can be scheduled or what information they can get, and/or offers to check back at a later time without implying full opt-out. It should not ask for DOB or use lookup_patient yet, since no appointment changes or PHI are needed.

checks.no_opt_out_called: Did the assistant avoid calling the opt_out tool in this turn?
checks.keeps_channel_open: Did the assistant keep the option open for future booking or questions rather than implying permanent unsubscribe?
